newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran says Swiss diplomat met detained U.S. citizen.
newsitem.headline: Iran says Swiss diplomat met detained U.S. citizen.

text.p: A Swiss consular official has visited a U.S. citizen arrested in Iran for entering the country illegally, the official news agency IRNA reported on Thursday.
IRNA quoted Iran's mission at the United Nations as saying in a statement on Wednesday that the consul has visited the American -- who has not been identified -- more than once.

"He has been visited more than once by a consular official of the Swiss embassy, which is in charge of the U.S. interests section in Tehran," IRNA, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation, quoted the statement as saying.
The head of Iran's judiciary, Ayatollah Mohammad Yazdi, said on Tuesday Iran had recently arrested a U.S. national for entering the country illegally, but did not give other details.
In Washington, the State Department said on Wednesday it has asked Switzerland, its go-between with Iran, to check into reports that the U.S. citizen has been arrested in Iran.
Iran and the United States do not maintain diplomatic relations and the United States advises its citizens against travel to Iran.
